name: Crystal Chaser: Tenkuu no Mashoukyuu
original_name: クリスタルチェイサー 天空の魔晶球
source:
For a long time, five magical crystal orbs have been protecting our universe. One of them was hidden on the Earth. But there was a young woman who desired too much power, and she came to the Earth in order to harvest the power of its crystal for her selfish purposes. The only ones who can stop her are Takanoshin, the son of a samurai warrior, and the young girl Noichigo, who teaches little children. Together, they embark on a long and perilous journey through the land of Japan...

[From MobyGames]
translation:
很久以来，五颗魔法水晶球一直守护着我们的宇宙。其中一颗被藏在地球上。然而，一名渴望过多力量的年轻女子为了满足自己的私欲来到地球，企图夺取那颗水晶的力量。能够阻止她的，只有武士之子鹰野信，以及教导孩子们的少女野莓。两人一同踏上漫长而危险的旅程，穿越日本大地……

（来源：MobyGames）
